shots.name: wp-dof-high
script: await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'town', alt: 2.5, pitch: 3, hour: 19.9 }); await G.frames(2);
G.cam_.photo(true); G.cam_.setLens({ aperture: 1.4, blur: 1, focus: 5, guides: 'none', frame: 'free' }); await G.frames(2); return G.cam_.lens();
